name: Silverlake Ramen Chashu Don Rice Bowl (Riverton)
brandOrRestaurant: Silverlake Ramen (Mountain View Village · Riverton, UT)
whyItWorks: Diced braised tender pork drizzled with sweet soy glaze over a large bowl of steaming white Calrose rice. Gentle on digestion without heavy soup oils.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Request NO green onion garnish and NO spicy mayo drizzle. Eat with plain white rice.
